name: branding-sparkle-crosshair-symbol-over-glasses-portrait
title: Violet sparkle-crosshair symbol and 'Flaren' wordmark over a high-resolution portrait
whatItIs: A full-size version of the cover: a woman in a plum hood and clear round glasses gazes upward in violet light, with the sparkle symbol and white 'Flaren' wordmark across the centre.
whatItMeans: Cinematic and focused; the glasses reflect the brand colour.
techniques: Let reflective props (glasses) carry brand colour.
Place the lockup across the face's midline.
Use dark photo edges to frame.
Set the wordmark in soft white.

vocabulary.definition: An object reflecting the brand colour.
Colour treatment like a film still.
A logo centred across the middle.
A slightly tinted white for text.
